name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flagStepC_le
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) (j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes γ)) →
    LE.le.{0}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flagStepC γ
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.buildList (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.flagStep γ) j) j)
      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 4 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.sizeInstance γ)) 1)
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.sizeInstance γ) 2)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.argsLen
            (List.getD.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes γ) j
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node.src 0)))))

source.code:
theorem flagStepC_le (j : ℕ) (hj : j < γ.nodes.length) :
    γ.flagStepC (buildList γ.flagStep j) j ≤
      4 * sizeInstance γ + 1 + (sizeInstance γ + 2) * argsLen (γ.nodes.getD j (.src 0)) := by
  have hmem := γ.nodes_getD_mem j hj (.src 0)
  have hlen : γ.nodes.length ≤ sizeInstance γ := γ.nodes_length_le
  have hfl : (buildList γ.flagStep j).length = j := buildList_length _ _
  have hx := γ.natC_x_le
  have hy := γ.natC_y_le
  have ha : accessC γ.nodes j ≤ sizeInstance γ + 1 := (accessC_le _ _).trans (by omega)
  unfold flagStepC
  cases hnd : γ.nodes.getD j (.src 0) with
  | src i =>
      rw [hnd] at hmem
      have := γ.nodeC_le_of_mem hmem
      simp only [nodeC] at this
      dsimp only [argsLen]
      show accessC γ.nodes j + (natC i + natC γ.x + natC γ.y) ≤ _
      omega
  | app f args =>
      dsimp only [argsLen]
      show accessC γ.nodes j + (args.map (fun a => 1 + accessC (buildList γ.flagStep j) a)).sum ≤ _
      have := sum_map_le_of_le args (fun a => 1 + accessC (buildList γ.flagStep j) a)
        (sizeInstance γ + 2) (by
          intro a _
          dsimp only
          have := accessC_le (buildList γ.flagStep j) a
          rw [hfl] at this
          omega)
      rw [Nat.mul_comm] at this
      omega
